metadata.title: Soulful Portrait with Venetian Blind Shadows

retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic close-up portrait characterized by high-contrast shadows from window blinds and a layered typographic hierarchy combining blocky headers with elegant script.
triggerTerms: warm amber lighting with deep shadows

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, soulful male portrait bathed in warm amber light, featuring a distinct pattern of diagonal shadows cast by window blinds. The composition is anchored by a purple horizontal bar at the top containing wide-set yellow sans-serif text, overlaid with a pink cursive script that breaks the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Shadow patterns interacting with facial contours
Warm amber skin tones against deep black shadows
Horizontal purple bar contrasting with vertical portrait orientation
Script text overlapping blocky sans-serif text
coreInvariants: Warm amber and deep brown color palette
Purple header bar with yellow typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up headshot occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's left eye, positioned at the intersection of light and shadow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the purple header bar down through the script signature, following the diagonal shadows to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows on the right side of the face and background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with saturated warm tones and deep, crushed blacks.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended geometric sans-serif and formal copperplate script
letterConstructionRules: Primary header uses extreme horizontal scaling
Secondary script uses high-contrast strokes and long flourishes
Bottom text uses wide tracking with serif characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' in the script is oversized and acts as a graphic divider
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid geometric expansion and fluid organic script.

preserve: Horizontal stretch of the top text
Wide tracking of the bottom text
avoid: Modern digital scripts without calligraphic weight

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, blocky aesthetic of the top header.
Captures the elegant, high-contrast script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with warm amber lighting and a distinct diagonal venetian blind shadow pattern across his face. Include a solid purple horizontal bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-expanded yellow sans-serif text centered in the purple bar. Overlay a pink calligraphic script name slightly below and to the right, overlapping the bar and the image. Add wide-tracked white serif text at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the shadow pattern diagonal and distinct?
Is the top text horizontally stretched?
Does the script text overlap the purple bar?

postGenerationChecks: Verify text expansion on the top line
Ensure the purple bar is a solid, clean graphic element
Confirm the script has a hand-written, elegant quality
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Venetian Shadows + Header Bar + Expanded Sans + Script Overlay
